name: How do multi-family project management services differ from single-family home construction?

mainEntity.name: How do multi-family project management services differ from single-family home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multi-family project management involves greater complexity due to the scale and density of construction. It requires expertise in managing multiple units, common areas, shared infrastructure, and often more stringent regulatory requirements, including accessibility and fire safety codes specific to multi-unit dwellings. While single-family focuses on individual client preferences, multi-family balances market appeal, investment returns, and efficiency across numerous units, demanding specialized coordination for larger teams and diverse subcontractor trades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Multi-family project management is more complex, involving multiple units, common areas, and stricter regulations than single-family home construction. It balances market appeal with efficiency across many units.
